feed_events.description:
The checking capability's op that records an imported feed's
differences from the kind.

intent.description:
False when a page never writes the kind's log by intent (absent:
it does, or the kind is in no log).

load.description: The kernel's load of the kind, when a module reads it from the bus.

log.description: The log that holds its records.

module.description: The capability that checks a write.

pick.description:
What a pick does with the kind: on an adoption, the argument that
names the seq of the kind's log it read; on an export, the checking
capability's op over the network and the kind's head.

pointers.description: The pointers it heads (`*` ends a prefix).

post.description: Its own write route, answered by its log's receive op.

receive.description: The capability whose `receive` op writes the kind's log.

references.description:
The fields that name other records or things, each with its
target, from the current version's schema (`x-references`, D-232).

route.description: Where it is written, in words a person reads in a refusal.

store_kind.description: The envelope's kind, or a log's document kind.

tag.description:
The tag the document carries inside it, which names its schema.
Empty for a kind with no schema of ours (a GTFS zip, a file of a
build).

validate.description: Its op that checks a write.

versions.description: The versions with a schema in this build.

work_order.description:
The route that sends its records to the work order system, and the
checking capability's ops that answer what to send and record the
answer.

LoadEntry.description: The kernel load of a kind names its JSON op and the code of its bytes op.

Merge.description: How two writes of a kind merge.

oneOf.description:
The write replaces the whole document, by CAS on the head that the
writer read.

The last writer wins for each record id, as in the edit document
(D-56).

The writes are ops over the head of the log. Writes to different
records do not conflict.
Only the server writes the kind.

PostEntry.description:
The write route of a kind names the path, the op that takes the request
body as its arguments, the answer field that names the document after
the write, and the body fields that the answer repeats.

oneOf.description: Anyone reads the kind by hash (`/blobs/<hash>`).

The server does not serve the kind by hash. A client reads only
its own projection.

A caller with the audit rule reads the kind. The entries of a log
name their writers.

RecordEntry.description: One record kind of a log, and where it lives in its document.

collection.description:
The document field that holds the collection, either an array of
records with an `id` or an object by id.

kind.description: The record's kind in a log entry's changes.

Reference.description:
The path is a JSON Pointer with `*` and `[tag=value]` added. A
declaration on an array applies to each item, so its path ends in `*`.

VersionEntry.description: One version of a kind, and its schema.

schema.description:
The schema's content hash (the store keeps it as
`schemas/<tag>.v<N>/<hex>.json`).

oneOf.description:
`POST /pointers/<name>`, where the name is one of `pointers`. The
`validate` op of the `module` checks the write, and the store
keeps what the module answers.
The kind has its own route (`route`), which runs its module.

Only the server writes the kind, in an import, a release, or the
manifest.

description: The kind table of one build.

kinds.description: Each kind the store keeps, by its store kind.

title: KindTable
